### Lowest z-score any answer can reach

With a 2 s floor on answer time and the per-question reference means and stds in improved_thresholds.json, the lowest possible z on a question is (2 - mean) / std. Across the 40 questions it ranges from -2.04 to -1.68 (median -1.89). Questions where z < -1.5 is reachable: 40 of 40; z < -2.0: 7 of 40; z < -2.5: 0 of 40.
